summary: Wrote an 8-phase, 13-hour plan for the M13 diagnostics standard, axiom audit and cost baseline. Research had already measured every baseline figure at commit 521385a9, so no phase is discovery work: each checks in the harness that reproduces an already-compiled number. Planning resolved the one decision research deferred (the new computable derivation node-count measure lands in BimodalLib/Diagnostics/, not FormalSystem/ProofSystem/Derivation.lean, because touching the core would move four generated surfaces, one of them commit-blocking via .githooks/pre-commit) and scheduled four same-phase gate collisions the research report had not enumerated (status.typ regeneration on every Tests/ addition, readme-lint Check 1 and Check 4, and C30's ban on an unscoped maxHeartbeats under scripts/, which sites the timing probe under specs/evidence/ instead). The plan validates clean with 0 warnings.

artifacts.summary: 8-phase plan (13h): gate baseline, axiom audit test module, diagnostics record schema plus derivation-size measure, the two emitter commands with #guard_msgs negative tests, the cost probe, docs/reference/diagnostics.md, the measuring script and emitted records, and the baseline document with the final gate.
